text:
noura: Quick recap from Vega pilot sync — they
want SSO + searchable audit in MVP and are asking to pull the pilot ~18 days earlier. they said pilot wont run without audit.

evan: 18 days earlier? that compresses our QA window. why the rush? @noura

noura: compliance + security gating on their side; they said the pilot is contingent on a written commitment.

mika: Searchable audit = index + retention + export surface. big infra/legal touchpoints. proposing two short options.

cole: Please outline A/B quickly so sales can push back or sign.

mika: A) baseline-MVP: auth core + OIDC SSO passthrough, events forwarded to customer sink (no indexed audit). keeps current milestone.

mika: B) customer-MVP: auth core + SSO + basic indexed audit (30d retention, simple query API) + signed export -> estimated +~2.5w, infra + KMS + legal.

mika: Quick tech delta sketch:
```
delta-B:
  infra: +1 index shard (region), +1 retention-store instance
  cost: ~$8k/mo (infra + ops)
  eng: +2.5w (~1.0 FTE equivalent)
  blockers: legal (data residency), KMS attestation, compliance signoff
```

sales-bot: NOTE: per policy we need a signed LOI before we provision retention infra. include LOI deadline in offer.

evan: If Vega signs LOI and covers 2 months of retention infra we can accept B with a formal 2-week timeline reset. otherwise offer a phased promise: SSO in MVP, indexed audit early v1 after LOI.

noura: If we take a reset, trade candidates: drop admin UI polish, postpone advanced telemetry, and defer an internal infra refactor. keeps customer-facing surface stable.

cole: Customer-facing blurb (draft): "We can include searchable audit artifacts in MVP conditioned on a written LOI that covers interim retention infrastructure costs; delivery timeline will shift by ~2 weeks upon LOI confirmation."

cole: Action items: @mika post full A/B cutlist with time/cost/risk and a one-paragraph customer blurb by EOD. @noura confirm LOI timing and legal constraints. reconvene tomorrow 09:30 PT to decide. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: Deploy note: auth-service canary scheduled 2025-10-28 02:00 UTC — coordinate feature flags and migrations if selecting the indexed cut.
